sources.title: Exact tagged SSOT row and Batch 0032 source-first boundary audit
Delete-duplicates-II deterministic Java validation against run-length oracle

claims.text: The exact repository source asks only for sorted-list duplicate removal II and identifies LeetCode 82; Java node shape, null-input behavior and in-place reuse are answer-side contracts.
The candidate uses sorted-run contiguity, a dummy predecessor and a monotonic scan to remove every node belonging to a repeated value while retaining singleton-value nodes.

Compiled Java validation matches an independent run-length oracle on fixed cases, all 3,003 nondecreasing lists through length 10 over -2..2, 20,000 deterministic random sorted lists and a 100,000-node large case with cycle guarding.
